concept.hr: NCS pretvara nadmetanje za kanal u red čekanja
concept.en: An NCS turns contention into a queue

summary.hr: Pet stanica ima poruku za isti kanal. Bez NCS-a tipkaju kad hoće i dupliraju se; s NCS-om, koji ih poziva redom i potvrđuje svaku poruku, nema sudara.
summary.en: Five stations have a message for one channel. Without an NCS they key up at will and double; with an NCS calling them in turn and ACKing each, none collide.

concept.hr: Jednake odgode ponavljaju dupliranje: 0 od 5 poruka u 20 odsječaka
concept.en: Identical backoffs repeat the doubling: 0 of 5 messages in 20 slots

concept.hr: Odgode 1, 1, 2, 2, 3: parovi se i dalje sudaraju, 0 od 5 u 20 odsječaka
concept.en: Backoffs 1, 1, 2, 2, 3: pairs keep colliding, 0 of 5 in 20 slots

concept.hr: Sve odgode različite: 5 poruka u 7 odsječaka, ali bez potvrda i bez reda
concept.en: All backoffs differ: 5 messages in 7 slots, but no ACKs and no order

concept.hr: NCS poziva redom: 12 odsječaka, nijedno dupliranje, svaka poruka potvrđena
concept.en: The NCS calls in turn: 12 slots, no doubling, every message ACKed

concept.hr: Isti incident bez NCS-a i s njim: nakon 12 odsječaka 0 prema 5
concept.en: The same incident without and with an NCS: 0 vs 5 after 12 slots
